# Theme factory: font-and-color themes for artifacts (short pointer)

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @composiohq's theme-factory: a toolkit for applying consistent professional styling to artifacts (slides, docs, reports, HTML landing pages). Ten curated themes — Ocean Depths, Sunset Boulevard, Forest Canopy, Modern Minimalist, Golden Hour, Arctic Frost, Desert Rose, Tech Innovation, Botanical Garden, Midnight Galaxy — each with a hex color palette and header/body font pairings, showcased in a `theme-showcase.pdf`; the workflow is show the showcase, let the user pick, confirm explicitly, then apply the theme's colors and fonts consistently.
